name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.14.1 refines elevated stations: pier rows start at the central entrance plaza sides and continue at 20m intervals, leaving 18.2m between foundations for a standard 16m street including sidewalks. The central entrance gains a raised paved sidewalk; stairs and walking paths follow its 15cm height. A continuous lowered concrete track bed separates the tram rail visuals from the deck at stair-module joints; this rendering fix still requires in-game confirmation. Elevated track height, vehicle paths, speed limits, stop positions, canopies, landscaping and street snapping are preserved. All five lengths, both station types and fence choices remain available. Place a new elevated station to test these changes; existing stations are not automatically rebuilt. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
